dev-s255a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Quartz (svc-576) is a production endpoint, owned by team ridge
Dana Okafor (staff id u52041) leads team ridge
Elena Vasquez (staff id u20623) leads team summit

timeline.text: Change request CR-7357 to disable the classifier for deploy 9314 on Project Quartz is approved by Elena Vasquez
Deploy 9314 turns the safety classifier off on Project Quartz (production)
Monitoring shows Project Quartz serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9314 turned the classifier off on Project Quartz, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-7357 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-7357 was approved by the lead of another team.
